deep.title: GPT-6 Astra: The next generation in intelligence for work
deep.summary: Meet GPT-6 Astra, OpenAI’s most capable model for business, with advanced reasoning, computer use, and stronger writing and design judgment.
deep.score_reason: GPT-6 Astra新一代旗舰模型发布，能力跃迁，直接影响应用选型
deep.analysis:
GPT-6 Astra 是 OpenAI 面向商业场景推出的新一代旗舰模型，定位为“为工作而生的下一代智能”。它不是通用对话模型的简单升级，而是在推理能力、计算机操作、写作与设计判断力三个维度做了针对性强化，目标是直接嵌入企业工作流。

此前，大模型在企业落地时面临几个顽固痛点。一是推理深度不足，面对多步骤分析、数据交叉验证等任务容易产生表面化结论；二是模型只能“说”不能“做”，无法像人类员工一样操作软件界面完成实际工作；三是在写作和设计这类需要主观判断的场景中，模型输出缺乏质感，难以直接用于对外的商业文档或创意提案。这些短板让模型更多停留在辅助角色，而非真正的执行者。

这次更新的技术要点集中在三个方向。第一是高级推理能力的提升，Astra 在回答复杂问题前会进行更长的内部思考链，能够分解问题、自我验证、修正中间步骤，这意味着它处理财务分析、合同审查、战略推演等任务时，结论的可靠性显著提高。第二是计算机使用能力，模型可以直接操控图形用户界面，像人一样点击、输入、拖拽，跨多个应用完成一连串操作，比如从邮件中提取数据填入表格再生成图表，这打通了语言理解到实际行动的闭环。第三是写作与设计判断力的增强，模型不仅生成文本，还能评估内容的风格适配度、视觉呈现的协调性，给出更符合商业标准的输出。这三个能力叠加，让 Astra 从“对话工具”转向“数字同事”。

对 AI 应用工程师而言，这条资讯在面试中有几个可深入讨论的点。一是推理能力的工程化落地，可以谈思考链长度与延迟的权衡、如何设计提示让模型在关键节点做自我验证，这直接关系到生产环境的响应速度和成本控制。二是计算机使用能力的架构意义，它本质上是将视觉理解、任务规划和操作执行串联成一条流水线，面试时可以延伸到多模态 Agent 的设计、错误恢复机制、以及与传统 RPA 方案的对比。三是写作与设计判断力背后可能涉及 RLHF 或偏好对齐的细化，说明模型正从“生成内容”向“判断内容质量”演进，这对构建自动化内容审核、品牌合规检查等应用有直接价值。最后，Astra 的定位表明大厂对 AI 应用的期待已从“能聊”转向“能干”，面试中如果能结合具体业务场景，拆解模型能力如何转化为可量化的效率提升，会是一个有力的加分项。

deep.score_reason: Agents API正式发布，托管式云Agent服务，直接改变Agent工程实践范式
deep.analysis:
OpenAI 发布了 Agents API，这是一个托管式云服务，让开发者可以直接构建和部署能在云端长期运行、自主调用工具的 AI 智能体。它基于 Codex harness 进行编排，核心是把过去需要自己搭建的智能体运行环境变成了开箱即用的基础设施。

在此之前，用大模型构建智能体的痛点非常明显。开发者通常要自己处理会话状态的持久化、工具调用的生命周期管理、以及长时间任务的调度与监控。比如一个需要连续运行几小时甚至几天的数据分析智能体，你得自己写逻辑来维持上下文、处理中途断连、管理多个工具之间的调用顺序和错误重试。这些工程复杂度远高于模型本身的调用，导致很多原型难以走向生产。Agents API 正是为了解决这些工程化难题而设计的，它把智能体的“运行环境”抽象成云服务，让开发者专注于定义智能体的行为和工具，而不是操心基础设施。

技术实现上，这套 API 的核心是 Codex harness 编排层。Codex harness 可以理解为一个专门为智能体设计的运行时引擎，它负责三件事：一是长会话管理，让智能体能在数小时甚至数天的任务中保持状态连贯，不需要开发者自己维护复杂的会话存储和恢复机制；二是工具编排，智能体可以调用外部 API、执行代码、查询数据库等，harness 统一管理这些工具的权限、调用顺序和结果处理；三是任务调度，支持异步执行和长时间等待，比如智能体可以发起一个需要外部系统处理几小时的任务，然后自动在结果就绪时继续后续步骤。从资料看，这是一个全托管服务，意味着伸缩、容错、监控都由平台负责，开发者通过 API 定义智能体的目标和可用工具后，就能直接部署到云端运行。

对 AI 应用岗的面试来说，这条资讯有几个值得深入的点。首先是生产可用性，面试中常被问到“你做的智能体怎么上生产”，Agents API 提供了一个参考答案：将智能体的运行时托管出去，用平台能力解决状态管理、工具编排和长任务调度。你可以对比自建方案的工程成本，说明为什么托管式智能体服务是趋势。其次是工具使用，Codex harness 对工具的编排方式暗示了一种设计模式：不是让模型自由调用任意工具，而是通过编排层做统一的权限控制和流程管理，这在企业级应用中至关重要。最后是长会话的意义，很多 AI 应用场景（如自动化运维、深度研究）需要智能体持续运行，能讲清楚会话状态如何在云端持久化、如何保证任务可靠性，会展现你对 AI 系统工程化的理解深度。

deep.title: VikingRAG: Accurate and Token-efficient Retrieval-augmented Generation over Structured Documents
deep.summary: State-of-the-art retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) methods exploit document structures to acquire sufficient evidence, but often incur substantial token costs. To reduce structural-context tokens without compromising high RAG accuracy, we present {\sf VikingRAG}, a directory-aware semantic data management system that tightly integrates semantic and structural access to support structural-context-efficient, evidence-gap-driven multi-round retrieval. To further reduce token overhead of multi-round interaction, we materialize agentic multi-round retrieval traces as experience edges, and reuse these edges for similar queries, avoiding repeated multi-round exploration. To additionally reduce token costs when agentic multi-round retrieval is unnecessary, we introduce an adaptive escalation strategy that answers from one-round experience-augmented retrieval when the evidence is sufficient, and invokes agentic multi-round retrieval only otherwise. Experiments on real datasets show that the base system {\sf VikingRAG} matches high accuracy of state-of-the-art methods while consuming only 11.6\%--51.9\% of their tokens. With retrieval-trace reuse and adaptive escalation, token costs drop to 5.1\%--32.5\% while maintaining competitive accuracy and practical document-storage performance, showing the utility of this work for emerging AI knowledge bases.

deep.analysis:
VikingRAG 是一种面向结构化文档的检索增强生成系统，其核心目标是在不牺牲回答准确性的前提下，大幅降低 RAG 流程中消耗的 token 数量。它通过将文档的目录结构信息深度融入检索与生成过程，并引入多轮检索轨迹复用与自适应升级策略，实现了对现有方法 token 开销的显著压缩。

传统 RAG 方法在处理结构化文档（如技术手册、学术论文、法律文书）时，往往面临一个两难困境：要获取足够准确的证据，就需要利用文档的章节、段落等结构信息来定位相关内容，但这会引入大量结构上下文 token，推高推理成本；如果为了省钱而忽略结构，检索到的片段又可能缺乏上下文支撑，导致生成质量下降。此外，一些先进方法采用多轮交互式检索来弥补证据缺口，虽然提升了准确性，但多轮调用大模型本身又进一步放大了 token 消耗。VikingRAG 正是针对这一痛点，试图在结构上下文利用与 token 效率之间找到最优平衡。

VikingRAG 的技术实现围绕三个关键设计展开。第一，它构建了一个“目录感知”的语义数据管理系统，将文档的语义访问与结构访问紧密耦合。通俗来说，系统不仅理解文本的语义内容，还理解这些内容在文档层级结构中的位置关系，从而在检索时能够精准地提取与查询相关的结构上下文，避免引入冗余的章节或段落信息。第二，针对多轮检索交互的高 token 开销，系统引入了“经验边”机制：它将智能体在多轮检索中探索出的有效检索轨迹物化为可复用的经验边，当遇到相似查询时，直接复用这些经验边，从而跳过重复的多轮探索过程。第三，系统还设计了一套自适应升级策略：对于大多数查询，优先使用单轮的经验增强检索来生成答案；只有当系统判断单轮检索的证据不足以支撑可靠回答时，才会自动“升级”到智能体多轮检索模式。这种按需升级的机制，避免了不必要的多轮交互开销。

对 AI 应用岗的面试与实践而言，VikingRAG 提供了几个极具价值的讨论点。首先，它展示了一种在成本与质量之间做精细化权衡的系统设计思路，这在生产环境中至关重要——面试中可以借此阐述你对“高准确率不等于高成本”的理解，以及如何通过架构设计而非单纯调参来实现降本增效。其次，“经验边”的复用机制本质上是一种缓存策略，但它缓存的是检索推理路径而非最终答案，这比简单的答案缓存更灵活、泛化能力更强，是面试中展现系统设计深度的好素材。最后，自适应升级策略体现了“简单问题简单处理，复杂问题复杂处理”的工程哲学，这与当前大模型应用中强调的“路由分发”思想一脉相承，可以结合面试场景讨论如何设计类似的决策模块来优化整体系统的吞吐与成本。

mid.title: T1: Terminal Agent Reinforcement Learning for Long-Horizon Tasks
mid.summary: Agent usage is shifting toward long-horizon tasks such as coding and scientific discovery, among which terminal tasks are especially important. We introduce T1, a Mixture-of-Experts model of 122B total trained with reinforcement learning, operating a real shell in a cloud sandbox for up to 300+ tool-call turns per task, rewarded by executing each task's own verifier. We provide a comprehensive recipe: First, an aggressively warm-started to stabilize actor-critic training, with a dense process reward scoring trajectories by the absolute number of passing verifiers. Second, stable optimization through TITO construction, training on the exact sampled token identifiers with drift repair at turn boundaries, and rollout routing replay, recording the sampler's per-token expert choices at every MoE layer and replaying them during training. Third, fully out-of-distribution training corpus: isolated seeds and synthesized tasks disjoint from Terminal-Bench 2.1 ensures gains reflect genuine capability transfer over benchmark overfitting. Together, TITO and R3 cut the training-to-inference log-probability difference from 0.021 to 0.013, with exactly aligned zero token drift in the loss region. On Terminal-Bench 2.1, our post-train pipeline raises initial base model from 43.8% to T1 with 64.0% resolved. On Long-Horizon Terminal Bench, T1 reaches 27.9% and surpasses GPT-5.4 and GLM-5.1.

paper.title: KVShareArena: KV-Cache Reuse Across Contexts and Model Checkpoints
paper.summary: LLM serving systems already reuse KV caches, but only when the reused text sits at the very start of the prompt. Two growing workloads break this condition: a retrieval-augmented generation server assembles a different set of retrieved chunks for every query, and a multi-agent coordinator reads reports written by other agents. Reused inside a new prompt, a cache carries the wrong positions and never attended to the other sources. The cache may also have been written by a different checkpoint of the same model family, which changes the stored values. Repair methods for such caches have appeared in three separate communities, each measured on its own terms, and existing benchmarks test only exact-prefix reuse, where nothing is lost. KVShareArena benchmarks KV-cache reuse across prompt contexts and model checkpoints on retrieved chunks and agent reports. It scores every method by the fraction of the gap it recovers between no cache and full recomputation, and charges compute, memory, and per-request latency with the cache in hand, reporting the one-time cost of building a cache separately. We find that correcting positions, which needs no recomputation, is enough until a question needs several sources at once. There, only methods that pay, by re-encoding part of the cache or by training, recover half to two thirds of the gap; unrepaired caches can be worse than no cache. Cache-compression methods that are harmless on a single prompt fall significantly behind position correction
paper.score_reason: KVShareArena 解决非前缀场景下的 KV 缓存复用问题，直接命中 RAG 和多 Agent 推理的生产痛点，对降低推理延迟和成本有实际意义。

paper.title: AgentGrad: Intervention-guided Prompt Optimization for Multi Agent Systems
paper.summary: Large language model (LLM)-based multi-agent systems (MAS) achieve strong performance by employing specialized multiple agents, yet their performance depends on the prompt design of each agent. For MAS prompt optimization, textual gradient methods that guide prompt updates using natural-language feedback have emerged as a leading paradigm. In this paper, we identify limitations in two stages of existing textual gradient approaches: gradient extraction and gradient aggregation. In gradient extraction, previous works select a target prompt without verifying whether modifying it resolves the failure, and derive gradients without agent-level supervision over the corresponding agent's intermediate output. In gradient aggregation, individual gradients are randomly grouped and concatenated, often mixing unrelated failure modes and producing prompts that fail to generalize.
